title: XLT-CrazyCrates
description: An addon to add a crate open objective for XLTournaments and CrazyCrates
body:
This addon adds a new objective for the plugin XLTournaments & CrazyCrates to allow a tournament that tracks the number of crates a user opens in CrazyCrates


# Requires:
[XLTournaments](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/xltournaments-%E2%9C%85-ultimate-global-tournament-plugin-%E2%AD%90-25-objective-types-1-20.70630/)

[CrazyCrates](https://modrinth.com/plugin/crazycrates)


# Configuration:
To use this objective, create a new tournament and set the objective type to `CRAZYCRATES_OPEN`
